statement: A joiner startup-authority projection consumes the seed-owned durable formation-release handoff contract for its own captured generation: projectFormationReleaseHandoff / validateFormationReleaseHandoffConsumerContract on a real joiner (join-branch admission cluster-incarnation-fence states, router evidence from the acceptor IDENTIFY reply only) yields formationReleaseHandoff.state active with releaseAuthorized true and startupAuthorityReady true while the seed retained generation is active across a priority-spread reopen, so the operation-ledger formation barrier resolves ledger_spread_satisfied from the whole-plane authority answer instead of the raw non-monotone spread predicate; the fence identity compared by the consumer is the authority published fence, never a hash of the reader own admission states, and every other consumer-contract predicate (authority boot incarnation, durable-vs-cached row projection, member connection evidence) is validated against what a real joiner holds. The formation-release GCP analyzer classifies a captured generation revoked by a valid disconnect after the authority entered NODE_DRAINING as teardown-truncated, not stranded. Seed-side capture, retention, revocation rules, the 60-second certification window and the single startup-authority owner are unchanged. Root cause from the 2026-08-30 02-15-53 GCP run (generation e1:4a36 [n1,n2,n4] retained 66.6 s across the reopen while joiners n1/n2 sat waiting_for_startup_authority with formationReleaseHandoffState null and reached READY only after the verdict) and from 20 runs since 2026-08-28 with 0/170 joiner barrier events carrying a handoff state.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The seed-owned formation-release handoff closure owner remains the sole minting authority; the joiner projection validates and consumes the seed's durable contract and never mints, extends, or locally re-derives release authority.

The join barrier and bootstrap readiness consume the same whole-plane authority answer the seed published; a joiner-side null projection of a valid retained generation is a defect, never a safe default. Fence, incarnation, epoch and topology checks stay fail-closed for genuinely mismatched contracts.

Seed capture/retention/revocation rules, the 60-second GCP certification window and the 120-second internal barrier, readiness floors, and the single startup-authority owner are unchanged. No sleeps, polling acceleration, or readiness weakening.

Prove through test/control-plane/formation-release-handoff-closure.test.js extended with a distinct real joiner process (join-branch admission fence states, acceptor-reply-only router evidence) red on HEAD and green after, plus an analyzer witness, before any GCP run.

Do not make the harness, analyzer, or readiness owner derive cluster-ACTIVE or READY from nodes.status, publication counts, or coverage; the analyzer change only reclassifies a teardown-truncated generation.
